candidates.summary: Iran said its seven-step proposal for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and resuming nuclear negotiations with the United States could be implemented within two days if Washington met its conditions. Earlier talks with Qatari mediators ended without a breakthrough, but Qatari mediators traveled to Tehran on Monday night to discuss a draft agreement with Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi. Vice President JD Vance said the countries had made some progress toward a negotiated settlement.
candidates.title: Qatari mediators return to Tehran after Iran outlines two-day Hormuz plan
candidates.geography: Iran; United States; Qatar; Strait of Hormuz

candidates.summary: The United States carried out limited strikes on Iranian targets on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, according to U.S. officials. One official said Iranian surface-to-air missile positions threatening U.S. assets were targeted. Iranian state media reported explosions on the island. U.S. Central Command had not publicly announced the operation at the time of the reports.
candidates.title: United States carries out limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island
candidates.geography: United States; Iran; Strait of Hormuz

candidates.summary: New York state and Lewis County health officials announced that a child had died in association with an ongoing measles outbreak. Officials described it as New York's first known measles-associated death in more than 30 years. The state reported 178 measles cases through October 24 and urged residents to check that they were current on measles, mumps and rubella vaccinations.
candidates.title: New York reports first measles-associated death in more than 30 years
candidates.geography: United States; New York; Lewis County

sources.name: New York State Department of Health

candidates.summary: Ukrainian authorities said Russian bombing of an aid distribution center and a neighboring shelter in the southern Kherson region killed 26 people. The attacks followed the expiration of a limited ceasefire that had allowed aid deliveries and evacuations in front-line and Russian-occupied areas.
candidates.title: Russian attacks on aid center and shelter kill 26 in southern Ukraine, officials say
